content:
Import bank statement

This screen allows you to import bank transactions from your statement file into your accounting system.

The import process will create receipt and payment transactions that match your bank statement.

Duplicate Detection

The system automatically identifies and excludes duplicate transactions to prevent double-entry.

Duplicates are detected by matching the transaction date, amount, and description.

Any transactions already imported will be skipped, ensuring your records remain accurate.

Import Summary

The summary table shows important information about your import:

• Current balance - Your bank account balance before importing new transactions

• Number of transactions in the file - Total transactions found in your bank statement

• Number of transactions already imported - Transactions that will be skipped as duplicates

• Number of transactions to import - New transactions that will be added to your records

• Closing balance after import - Your expected balance after the import completes

Review these numbers carefully before proceeding. All imported transactions will be marked as cleared.

After Import

Imported transactions become receipts (for deposits) or payments (for withdrawals).

Each transaction will have an automatic reference number assigned.

You can edit these transactions later to add more details, assign to specific accounts, or correct categorization.

Click the Import button to complete the process and add the transactions to your records.
